superAdminsOnly: Only a super admin can see the AI agent's prompts and turns: a turn holds a customer's words.

prompts.title: AI prompts
prompts.intro: The fixed words the lite WhatsApp agent's two model calls are given, as they are now. A turn's trace names the versions it used.

callIntro.understand: Reads the chat and fills in the form. It never writes to the customer.
callIntro.write: Writes the words of the one move code picked.

prompts.system: System message, the same every turn: {pieces}
prompts.blocks: Then this turn's blocks, in this order. A block with nothing in it is left out.
prompts.answer: Answers in JSON, to the schema “{name}”.
prompts.lookups: Asks for up to 4 lookups, which code runs before Write: {tools}.
prompts.fixedTexts: Code sends these texts itself. No model writes them.

traces.title: AI turns
traces.intro: Every turn the lite WhatsApp agent took in this agency's chats in the last 14 days, newest first. A turn's trace is deleted after 14 days, and at once when its customer is erased.
traces.chatIntro: One chat's turns in the last 14 days, newest first.
traces.empty: No turns in the last 14 days. Only an agency on the lite agent has them.
traces.noPricesDescription: Set AI_PRICE_INPUT_PAISE_PER_MILLION and AI_PRICE_OUTPUT_PAISE_PER_MILLION on the console to see what each turn cost. Until then, tokens only.
